title: Why You Feel So Alert After a Short Nap
hook: Feeling sluggish even after a long night's sleep?

narration.text: A short nap can make you feel more alert, even if you are still tired.
This is because of a molecule called adenosine that builds up in your brain.
High adenosine levels make you feel sleepy and tired.
During your nap, your brain clears some of this adenosine away.
Crucially, a short nap avoids deep sleep stages.
Waking from deep sleep makes you feel groggy and disoriented.
So, keeping naps under 30 minutes can boost your alertness.
Have you found short naps make you feel more productive?

description: Ever wonder why a quick nap sometimes leaves you feeling refreshed and ready to go? It all comes down to brain chemistry and the sleep cycle. Learn the secret behind power naps.
topic: Why you feel more alert after a short nap, explaining the sleep cycle stages and adenosine.
